📋 1. Original Purpose & Intent

The Future of PMM was created to answer a question that kept coming up across PMM teams: "How should we adapt our skills and workflows for an AI-transformed world?"

The intent was threefold:

  • Educate — Build a structured curriculum that teaches PMMs how AI changes the buyer journey, content strategy, competitive intelligence, and core PMM deliverables
  • Experiment — Test interactive AI labs that demonstrate what's possible when PMMs work alongside AI tools in their daily work
  • Validate — Prove the concept with a small cohort before scaling to all SAP PMMs
Core Hypothesis: AI doesn't replace PMMs — it amplifies them. But only if PMMs develop the right skills and learn to collaborate with AI as a "co-worker," not just a tool.

Current Lab Capabilities

Messaging Lab Draft and refine positioning statements, value props, and persona-specific messaging with AI feedback

Vision: PMM Co-Pilot on SAP Infrastructure

The Opportunity: Transform these experimental labs into production-ready AI agents that operate within SAP's existing AI infrastructure (Joule, SAP AI Core) with proper guardrails around PMM work.

A PMM Co-Pilot could automate and assist across the entire Book of Work — both areas PMM leads and areas PMM supports:

PMM Leads / Accountable (11 Areas)

01 Messaging & Positioning Draft positioning frameworks, test message variants, ensure consistency across assets
02 Category Storytelling Generate use-case narratives, adapt stories for different personas, maintain POV consistency
03 Market Insights Synthesize competitive signals, analyst reports, and field feedback into actionable recommendations
04 Launch Narrative Draft and refine launch briefs, ensure alignment with approved messaging
05 Adoption Strategy Analyze adoption patterns, recommend expansion plays based on customer data
06 Customer Personas Build and maintain dynamic personas that evolve with real buyer behavior
07 Commercialization Connect value narratives to pricing, packaging decisions
08 Launch & Disclosure Manage tiering, lock messaging, prepare readiness checklists
09 GTM & Field Readiness Generate sales enablement assets, objection handling guides, competitive quick-cards
10 Demo Create demo scripts, prioritize use-case flows for specific buyer segments
11 Customer Reference Match reference customers to prospect needs, draft reference request outreach

PMM Partners / Supports (8 Areas)

Where PMM shapes strategy, messaging, or requirements while partner teams own execution:

01 Marketing Planning Generate audience insights, narrative inputs, and portfolio context for Integrated Marketing
02 Campaign Execution Provide approved messaging, buyer context, launch timing inputs to Digital and Field Marketing
03 Press & Communications Draft product truth documents, spokesperson context, and narrative guardrails for PR/Comms
04 Partner & ISV Generate partner-facing positioning, business value content, and launch context
05 Pricing Communication Create buyer-facing value narratives, ROI framing, and packaging translation
06 Community Define community strategy, audience priorities, and customer community direction
07 Learning Journeys Provide messaging and role-based content strategy for Learning teams
08 Customer Journey Content Define what to say, to which audiences, and why — Integrated Marketing packages at scale

Guardrails Required:

  • Operates only on approved messaging and brand guidelines
  • Human review required before external publication
  • Audit trail for all AI-generated content
  • Integration with existing content management and approval workflows

Immediate: Site Migration

A complete Migration Guide has been prepared documenting:

  • Current architecture (Netlify, Supabase, Resend, AI APIs)
  • Database schema and data export procedures
  • SAP BTP equivalents (HANA Cloud, SAP IAS, Cloud Foundry)
  • Phase-by-phase migration plan
Migration Status: Documentation complete. Ready to hand off to IT for infrastructure provisioning.

In Progress: SuccessFactors Learning

The 12-unit curriculum is being adapted for SuccessFactors Learning to enable:

  • Formal completion tracking and certification
  • Integration with employee learning records
  • Scalable delivery to all SAP PMMs globally
  • Manager visibility into team skill development

Phase 03: Embed — Book of Work Integration

As the organization moves to Phase 03, the ultimate vision is a PMM operating environment where:

  1. Learning — PMMs complete the curriculum to build foundational AI-era skills
  2. Tools — AI agents assist with each of the 19 Book of Work areas (11 lead + 8 support)
  3. Guardrails — All AI-assisted work operates within approved guidelines and audit trails
  4. Measurement — Track engagement and contribution across the 500 PMMs
The Book of Work Comes Alive: Instead of static process documentation, the Book of Work becomes an interactive system — with AI agents that help PMMs execute each area while maintaining quality standards and strategic alignment. Playbooks ship. Recognition programs activate. Engagement is measured at every step.

✅ The Bottom Line

The pilot proved the model. Now it's time to scale.

The Future of PMM pilot achieved its objectives:

  • Validated demand — 181 users registered, 53 provided feedback, NPS of 9.1
  • Proved the curriculum — 73% pass rate, strong qualitative feedback on learning outcomes
  • Demonstrated lab potential — Interactive AI tools showed what PMM co-pilots could enable
  • Prepared for scale — Migration guide complete, SuccessFactors integration in progress

The next phase is clear: move the curriculum to corporate infrastructure, integrate with SuccessFactors for formal learning paths, and explore how the lab prototypes can evolve into production AI agents that make the Book of Work actionable across all SAP PMM teams.

Thank you for your support of this initiative.
